text: The Mackey-Glass system used in the lab is generated from what kind of equation?
choices: A partial differential equation in one spatial dimension
A system of three coupled ordinary differential equations
explanation: benchmarks.py and Appendix E.3 define dx/dt = β·x(t−τ)/(1+x(t−τ)^n) − γ·x(t): a delay differential equation, since the derivative depends on a past value x(t−τ). The 3-coupled-ODE option describes Lorenz; the 1D PDE describes Kuramoto-Sivashinsky.
